WITH actor_film_counts AS (
  SELECT actor_id, COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) as film_count
  FROM film_actor
  GROUP BY actor_id
),
total_distinct_films AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT film_id) as total_films
  FROM film_actor
),
actor_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    afc.actor_id,
    afc.film_count,
    CAST(afc.film_count AS REAL) / tdf.total_films AS ratio
  FROM actor_film_counts afc, total_distinct_films tdf
),
average_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM actor_ratios
)
SELECT 
  ar.actor_id,
  ar.film_count,
  ar.ratio,
  ar.ratio - avr.avg_ratio as difference_from_average
FROM actor_ratios ar, average_ratio avr
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC
LIMIT 10
